title: Copy single trigger_ai task with update note
description: Each trigger_ai task row needs its own Copy button. Clicking it copies that one task's id/title/description to clipboard, with a note that Claude should update the existing task (not create a new one) and add a one-line summary of new info.

title: Don't auto-archive on done; add explicit Archive button
description: Clicking the status toggle ○ → ✅ Done immediately removed the row, so there was no way to keep cycling through error / trigger_ai. Done is now just a status; an explicit 📥 Archive button (visible on done rows only) moves the task to the archive section.

title: Status changes not saved after update
description: writeStatuses() never checked file_put_contents() return value, so a failed write (bad permissions, missing storage dir) would silently succeed. The UI updated optimistically but statuses reverted on reload. Fixed by returning bool from writeStatuses and propagating the error through the AJAX response.

title: Status toggle fixed to far right of task row
description: Batch select checkbox stays left-most, status toggle (○) must be right-most. Added margin-left:auto to guarantee it regardless of browser/version.

title: Future steps toggle button right-aligned
description: Minimize future steps section by default. Header shows title + count only; expand/collapse button sits at the far right. Clicking it toggles ▶/▼ and shows or hides the content.

title: Login page: use nav logo, not static icon
description: Login page hardcoded icon-192.png. Replace with same priority chain as the nav (logo-icon-light → logo-horizontal-light → logo-nav → icon-192.png fallback).

title: Clean up legacy upcoming files and dead code
description: Remove stale storage/platform_tasks.json and storage/future_steps.json (replaced by config/platform_tasks.json + storage on live server). Drop dead CSS for done badges/rows since done tasks never appear in the active list.

title: Copy AI tasks button on upcoming page
description: Add a button to /settings/upcoming that copies all trigger_ai tasks (id, title, description) to clipboard in a paste-ready format. Visible only when trigger_ai count > 0.

title: Future steps section collapsed by default
description: The Future Steps box on the task log page should be minimized on load. Click the header to expand it. Shows a count badge when collapsed.

title: Task log: right-align status, archive section
description: Status toggle button moved to far right of each task card. Done tasks removed from main list and moved to a collapsed archive section with a .txt download only.

title: Harvest tracking per seed per year
description: When a line is harvested, log the plant count to seed_harvest_log (seed_id, bed_id, plant_count, harvested_on). Family needs shows harvest totals for the current year and 2 previous years.

title: Seed in-ground count via bed write triggers
description: Pre-calculated seed_ground_cache table updated on every bed write (plant, trash, harvest, adjust, config change). Family needs reads from cache instead of live query to fix count accuracy.

title: Future steps must stay in storage, not config
description: future_steps.json is user-only data and must live in storage/ so upgrades never wipe it. Moving it to config/ caused user's steps to be deleted on upgrade.

title: Claude must never set task status except trigger_ai
description: Status (done, error, trigger_ai, empty) is managed exclusively by the user. Claude may only change trigger_ai back to empty after processing. Never auto-set done on commit.

title: Task log: (ZONE) prefix rule + config deploy fix
description: Tasks were not appearing on live site because platform_tasks.json was in storage/ (excluded from ZIP). Moved to config/. New rule: any message starting with (ZONE) is always logged.

title: Future steps: edit button + disable Enter key
description: Add an Edit button to each future step card that reopens the step in the top textarea. Disable Enter-to-submit (multi-line field only in this section). Cancel button resets the form.

title: Family needs: phantom line count bug fix
description: Reducing bed lines (e.g. 3 to 1) left orphan growing records on removed lines that inflated plant counts in family needs. Fixed by filtering seedGroundStats to only count lines within the current bed_rows setting.

title: Upcoming page: future steps box with zones
description: Add a separate Future Steps section at the top of Settings Task Log. Supports (ZONE) targeting, multi-line input, drag-to-reorder, copy content, and delete per item.

title: Family needs: multi-seed linked selection
description: The Linked Seed field on Add Yearly Need should allow selecting multiple seeds. When you have several carrot varieties, any of them should satisfy the need.

title: Redesign upcoming page as live task tracker
description: Replace version-based roadmap with a request-driven task log stored in platform_tasks.json. Status cycles empty to done to error to trigger_ai.

title: App icon on login page
description: Add the Rooted app icon above the Sign In heading on the auth login page. Centred with rounded corners and soft shadow.

title: Garden bed drag-to-reorder within a garden
description: Add a drag handle to each bed row so beds can be reordered per garden. Order saved via AJAX to items.sort_order and persists across page loads.

title: Action log reminder INSERT non-fatal
description: Wrap the reminder INSERT in addAction() with try/catch so a reminder schema failure can never crash the whole log request.

title: Garden bed reordering + action log fix
description: Beds within a garden can be drag-reordered via sort_order on items. Action log reminder INSERT wrapped in try/catch so the log always saves even if reminder fails.
